answer: Random sampling, not spot checks, prices a sybil. Each epoch the protocol draws a small verifier panel from the epoch seed, so every answer carries a fixed audit chance nobody can foresee or bribe. One key meets it once; a farm of a thousand linked keys meets a thousand independent draws, so the chance one duplicate is caught nears certainty, and shared liability voids the cluster on first proof. Fines must exceed a window of fake earnings, making forgery a bad bet. A juniper, a sparrow, a patch of yarrow fit any paragraph, so inclusion proves nothing; scale is what sampling taxes.
